$comment: LUSL migration scope, checked by scripts/python/lusl_migration.py through source_policy.py
shaders are LUSL: each wave adds the directories it ports, and the gate then rejects any Slang
source (.slang/.slangh) there that 'retained' does not name. 'retained' lists the Slang files or
directories the repository keeps, each with the reason it stays Slang. Paths are

retained.reason: RHI interface vocabulary that LUSL lowering writes against (raster_bindings.slang, ray_query.slang, runtime_bindings.slang)
RHI tests of Slang input: graph ray queries, ordered compute and raster storage
Differential oracle: a renderer GPU test compares its pixels with tests/lusl_composite.lusl
Legacy-format render-graph template fixtures that the template update and capture warmup tests read

Slang input of the installed shader helper's contract scripts (verify_shader_build.py and the macOS and Windows scripts) and differential oracle: the RHI parity test compares its pixels with diagnostic.lusl
export_compute.py splices it into the slice_sampling_luminaire render-graph template's Slang shading; it migrates with that template (L5d wave 3)
Uniform block of diagnostic.slang that the helper contract scripts edit to check include rebuilds and the 16 KiB uniform bound
Mip-streaming fixture that reads the bound view's mip count through Slang's GetDimensions level form; LUSL's GetDimensions() returns level-zero extents only
RHI binding-array test of Slang input: r11arrays indexes images with NonUniformResourceIndex and r11runtime samples a runtime-sized array; LUSL binding arrays take constant indices and a named size
RHI binding-array test of Slang input: a ConstantBuffer array, which LUSL binding arrays (sampled textures and samplers) do not express
RHI binding-array test of Slang input: an RWStructuredBuffer array, which LUSL binding arrays (sampled textures and samplers) do not express
